$comment: A shared asset root: every profile that lists it in profiles.json serves these entries from its own asset index, and their files from /catalog/packs/emoji-packs/. One pack, one copy, every brand. checksum, size and added are generated by `pnpm run build:catalog` exactly as they are for a brand catalog. Each entry's `rights` record and its `meta.emoji` block are generated by `node scripts/import-emoji-pack.ts <family> --bundle=all --bundle-out=<file>`, which prints the entry to register.

assets.name: Twemoji Color
assets.description: The complete Twemoji 17.0.3 emoji set: all 3,953 canonical Unicode 17 glyphs, flags and skin tones included, as one bundle file. Choosing a set is what stops a canvas or an export drawing the operating system's own emoji, so the same text looks the same on every device and in every exported file. The bundle carries the exact pack manifest plus each glyph's untouched source SVG, it is fetched only when a set is chosen, and an export that places one records the set's licence as a Content Credentials source.

assets.name: OpenMoji Color
assets.description: The OpenMoji 17.0.0 colour set as one bundle file: 4,315 glyphs, which is 3,949 of the 3,953 canonical Unicode 17 keys plus 366 of the project's own symbols. Its licence is CC BY-SA 4.0, so the credit travels with every export and a recoloured glyph is an adaptation: share one and the export panel asks for a compatible licence. Four Unicode glyphs and one symbol are absent because their upstream files carry defects the renderer refuses, and meta.emoji.missing names each one with its reason.
